name: smartseason
description: SmartSeason Field Monitoring System - Unified Runner

scripts.build: cd smartseason-frontend && bun run build && mv dist ../dist
scripts.setup: bun run setup:backend && bun run setup:frontend && bun run setup:db
scripts.setup:db: cd smartseason-backend && bunx prisma generate && bunx prisma migrate dev --name init && node seed.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd smartseason-backend && bun run dev" "cd smartseason-frontend && bun run dev"
